descriptionText: You are comparing how 6 SDG classification models score 1,986 human-labeled validation examples against the human ground truth (the "Human Label" column). Items come from two reference sets — the UZH ZORA labeled publications and the OSDG Community excerpts — and are grouped by dataset, then by the SDG each example was annotated against (across 17 SDGs). Each model cell is its predicted alignment of the example with that SDG, from 0 to 100%; the Human Label is 100 for a positive human judgement and 0 for a negative one.
